def test_export_builder_keeps_ledger_rule_and_sign():
    from invoice import build_export
    rows = [
        {"invoice": "I2", "item": "B", "quantity": "1", "unit_price": "1.00", "tax_class": ""},
        {"invoice": "I1", "item": "A", "quantity": "1", "unit_price": "0.335", "tax_class": "standard"},
        {"invoice": "I1", "item": "C", "quantity": "1", "unit_price": "0.335", "tax_class": "standard"},
        {"invoice": "I1", "item": "D", "quantity": "1", "unit_price": "0.335", "tax_class": "standard"},
        {"invoice": "I1", "item": "R", "quantity": "-1", "unit_price": "0.100", "tax_class": "exempt"},
    ]
    out = build_export(rows)["invoices"]
    assert [i["id"] for i in out] == ["I1", "I2"]
    assert out[0]["total"] == "0.92"
    assert [l["item"] for l in out[0]["lines"]] == ["A", "C", "D", "R"]
    assert out[0]["lines"][-1]["amount"] == "-0.10"
    assert "tax_class" not in out[1]["lines"][0]


def test_export_command_writes_file(tmp_path):
    import json
    from invoice import load, write_export
    path = write_export(load(), tmp_path / "x" / "invoices.json")
    data = json.loads(path.read_text())
    assert data["invoices"][0]["total"] == "0.92"
